Stop.command: bash -c 'p=$(cat); ws=$(printf %s "$p" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"workspacePaths\") or [\"\"])[0])" 2>/dev/null); s="$ws/scripts/harness-stop-hook.sh"; [ -x "$s" ] || exit 0; printf %s "$p" | exec "$s"'

hooks.command: bash -c 'p=$(cat); ws=$(printf %s "$p" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"workspacePaths\") or [\"\"])[0])" 2>/dev/null); s="$ws/scripts/harness-pretool-hook.sh"; [ -x "$s" ] || { printf %s '{"decision":"allow"}'; exit 0; }; printf %s "$p" | exec "$s"'
